test_title: PYST 24: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 19th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: X is the brother of Y. Y is the sister of Z. Z is the mother of W. How is X related to W?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) X is the brother of Y.

2) Y is the sister of Z.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5ba3f5b6aebf75d4589140d6b47665ee6c6fd8d6a74522f60b04d900630148f.png] 

3) Z is the mother of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/553f084a698c42c5a69717a127dc409047a3e5e9cad3756ff8401963e8ba5cbf.png] 

Thus, X is W's uncle.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
